sql: SELECT s.School, s.DOC FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3 FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.Charter = 0 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY s.City
SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2 FROM schools s WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino' AND s.City = 'San Bernardino' AND s.DOC = '54' AND s.SOC = '62' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f JOIN satscores t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / t.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT s.School, s.Street FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm f JOIN satscores t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND t.NumGE1500 > 0
SELECT t.sname, f.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores t JOIN frpm f ON t.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' AND t.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
SELECT s.School, t.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone FROM schools s LEFT JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm f ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE t.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.CharterNum, t.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE t.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC
